capabilities: Bake pasted or dropped images into notes as Base64 embeds without creating attachment files
Convert existing wiki and markdown image embeds in place, per image, note, or whole vault
Extract baked embeds back into image files with original names and folders restored
Re-encode images to WebP or JPEG with optional downscaling while baking
Copy baked images back to the clipboard and manage them from a per-note sidebar
extras: README states the TypeScript source is mainly generated with LLM assistance. Installable via BRAT; the community-catalog listing appears pending. Documents limits: Base64 inflates note size ~33%, Bases/card views don't render baked images, GitHub strips data-URI images, Excalidraw and Canvas out of scope, mobile paste untested. Release builds carry GitHub artifact attestations.
problem: Obsidian stores embedded images as separate attachment files, so notes are not self-contained, screenshot-heavy workflows clutter the vault, and deleted notes leave orphaned attachments.
summary: Image embed manager that bakes images into notes as self-contained Base64 embeds and extracts them back into vault files, reversibly.
